build_fasta_dataset: build a FastaDataset from a FASTA file path with optional index caching for protein sequences
build_encoded_fasta_dataset: build an EncodedFastaDataset that returns token indices using a dictionary instead of raw sequences
test_fasta_dataset_getitem: test the FastaDataset __getitem__ method to retrieve a description and sequence by index
review_fasta_dataset_build_index: review the FastaDataset _build_index method that uses grep and awk to parse byte offsets and sequence lengths
summarize_fasta_dataset_exists: summarize the FastaDataset exists static method that checks if a FASTA file exists at the given path
